# Map reference

The map of situations: the proposal `driftbench extract` writes, and the approved map a person makes of it, which `generate`, `space`, `intake` and `pilot` read; see [generating](../generating.md). Both files have this shape; an approved map is a proposal whose entries are approved. The page lists every field, generated from the zod schemas the CLI uses.

* Keys are snake_case. An unknown key is an error.
* Descriptions come from the schemas. An empty cell means the schema has no description for that field yet.

## Proposal

A map proposal: dimensions, values, constraints, phrases and relations, each waiting for approval.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `1` | yes |  | The version of the proposal format, 1. |
| `agent` | string, not empty | yes |  | The agent the map describes. |
| `produced_by` | [ProducedBy](#producedby) | yes |  | Who proposed the entries. |
| `sources` | list of [ProposalSource](#proposalsource), at least 1 item | yes |  | A file the entries quote. |
| `dimensions` | list of [ProposalDimension](#proposaldimension) | yes |  | One axis a situation varies on, with its values. |
| `constraints` | list of [ProposalConstraint](#proposalconstraint) | yes |  | A combination of values that cannot occur. |
| `phrases` | list of [ProposalPhrase](#proposalphrase) | yes |  | One phrasing of a value, for the phrase bank. |
| `numeric_settings` | list of [NumericSetting](#numericsetting) | no |  | Approved numeric ranges sampled by --budget into given.vars. |
| `relations` | list of [Proposal relations](#proposal-relations) | no |  | Paths, tool calls, concrete values, recoveries and the reply language, each with its quote. |

## ProducedBy

Who proposed the entries.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `family` | string, not empty | yes |  | The model family, `code` for the code pre-pass alone. |
| `model` | string, not empty | yes |  | The model as its provider names it. |
| `at` | string matching `^(?:(?:\d\d[2468][048]\|\d\d[13579][26]\|\d\d0[48]\|[02468][048]00\|[13579][26]00)-02-29\|\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]\|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|3[01])\|(?:0[469]\|11)-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|30)\|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]\|1\d\|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\d\|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d:[0-5]\d(?:\.\d+)?(?:Z))$` | yes |  | When the proposal was produced, in UTC. |

## ProposalSource

A file the entries quote.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | [SourceKind](#sourcekind) | yes |  | What the file is: the prompt or policy, the behaviour inventory, or the tool schemas. |
| `path` | string, not empty | yes |  | The path of the file, relative to the folder of the proposal. |

## SourceKind

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `prompt` | The agent's prompt or policy, read with --prompt and split into chunks for the model sections. |
| `inventory` | The behaviour inventory, read with --inventory; the code pre-pass derives behaviour, flow, deviation and channel dimensions from it. |
| `tools` | The tool schemas, read with --tools; the code pre-pass derives one data dimension per argument or result field. |

## ProposalDimension

One axis a situation varies on, with its values.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*$` | yes |  | A short id, unique among the dimensions, such as stage or coverage.check.in.address. |
| `title` | string, not empty | yes |  | What the dimension varies. |
| `kind` | [DimensionKind](#dimensionkind) | yes |  | What the dimension varies: a flow stage, a behaviour or rule, a deviation class, a kind of user, a channel, a data case, or a task setting for code agents. |
| `role` | [Role](#role) | yes |  | axis: a dimension of the space map, crossed with the other axes. detail: varied by the generator inside a cell, as boundary values. |
| `produced_by` | [Origin](#origin) | yes |  | Who proposed the entry: code (the pre-pass) or a model (a section answer). |
| `approved` | boolean | yes |  | The approval of the dimension and every value without its own flag. |
| `values` | list of [ProposalValue](#proposalvalue), at least 1 item | yes |  | One value of a dimension. |

## DimensionKind

What the dimension varies: a flow stage, a behaviour or rule, a deviation class, a kind of user, a channel, a data case, or a task setting for code agents.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `stage` | The dimension varies the stage of the flow the conversation is at. |
| `behaviour` | The dimension varies a behaviour or rule the agent follows. |
| `deviation` | The dimension varies the deviation class a user brings into the conversation. |
| `persona` | The dimension varies the kind of user who writes. |
| `channel` | The dimension varies the channel the user comes through. |
| `data` | The dimension varies a data case, such as one partition of a tool argument or result field. |
| `task` | The dimension varies a task setting for code agents; a conversation event allows only none on it. |

## Role

axis: a dimension of the space map, crossed with the other axes. detail: varied by the generator inside a cell, as boundary values.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `axis` | The dimension is an axis of the space map, crossed with the other axes. |
| `detail` | The generator varies the dimension inside a cell, as boundary values. |

## ProposalValue

One value of a dimension.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$` | yes |  | A short id, unique among the values of its dimension. |

| `limit` | integer, greater than 0 | no |  | The most times the action may happen in a conversation. |
| `within` | [ProposalValue within](#proposalvalue-within) | no |  | The time within which the action happens. |
| `priority` | `first` | no |  | The rule comes first when rules collide. |
| `weight` | number, 0 to 1 | no |  | The share of users the value stands for. |
| `required` | boolean | no |  | Whether a test plan must include the value. |
| `produced_by` | [Origin](#origin) | yes |  | Who proposed the entry: code (the pre-pass) or a model (a section answer). |
| `approved` | boolean | no |  | Overrides the dimension's flag for this value. Absent: the value inherits it. |

## Proposal relations

A relation between values: a path, a tool call, what a reply states, concrete values, a recovery, a reply language, the replies per turn.

Write one of these forms.

* a mapping with `kind: path`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `kind: uses_tool`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `kind: states`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `kind: task_family`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `kind: binds`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `kind: recovery`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `kind: reply_language`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `kind: tool_order`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `kind: route`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `kind: reply_text`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `kind: reply_count`, with the fields below

With `kind: path`:

A flow's stage order on one branch: the stages it passes when the cell holds `when`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `path` | yes |  | Marks the relation as a path: a flow's stage order on one branch. |
| `id` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$` | yes |  | A short id, unique among the paths. |
| `flow` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$` | yes |  | The flow the path belongs to: a value of the flow dimension. |
| `when` | map of string to list of strings, each matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$`, at least 1 item | no |  | The values the entry applies to, per dimension: { coverage_result: [fiber, 5g-only] }. |
| `stages` | list of strings, each matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$`, at least 2 items | yes |  | The stages in the order the conversation passes them, the start first. |
| `behaviours` | list of strings, each matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$` | no |  | The behaviours the path exercises. |
| `end_state` | [Proposal relations path end_state](#proposal-relations-path-end_state) | no |  | What the side-effect store must hold when the path ends, by slot values. |
| `evidence` | [Evidence](#evidence) | yes |  | Where the entry comes from: a source path and a quote from it. |
| `produced_by` | [Origin](#origin) | yes |  | Who proposed the entry: code (the pre-pass) or a model (a section answer). |
| `approved` | boolean | yes |  | False until a person approves the entry. |

With `kind: uses_tool`:

A tool a flow or a behaviour calls, the stage it is called at, and what feeds its inputs.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `uses_tool` | yes |  | Marks the relation as a tool call a flow or a behaviour makes. |
| `subject` | [Proposal relations uses_tool subject](#proposal-relations-uses_tool-subject) | yes |  | The flow or behaviour value that calls the tool. A flow's call is made on a move; a behaviour's call is made in the turn that asks for the behaviour, never on a move. |
| `tool` | string, not empty | yes |  | The tool label. |
| `stage` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$` | yes |  | The stage the call is made at: the turn that leaves this stage. |
| `to` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$` | no |  | Only on the turn that reaches this stage. |
| `when` | map of string to list of strings, each matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$`, at least 1 item | no |  | The values the entry applies to, per dimension: { coverage_result: [fiber, 5g-only] }. |
| `count` | integer, at least 0 or [Proposal relations uses_tool count](#proposal-relations-uses_tool-count) | no |  | Calls in that turn; 1 when absent. |
| `input` | map of string to [Proposal relations uses_tool input value](#proposal-relations-uses_tool-input-value) | no |  | The arguments, by name; `{slot}` reads the value a data value of the cell binds. |
| `evidence` | [Evidence](#evidence) | yes |  | Where the entry comes from: a source path and a quote from it. |
| `produced_by` | [Origin](#origin) | yes |  | Who proposed the entry: code (the pre-pass) or a model (a section answer). |
| `approved` | boolean | yes |  | False until a person approves the entry. |

With `kind: states`:

What the reply of one turn must and must not state, read from the values the cell binds.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `states` | yes |  | Marks the relation as what the reply of one turn must and must not state. |

| `must` | list of strings, each not empty, at least 1 item | no |  | Patterns the reply of that turn holds, such as a quoted price; `{slot}` reads a bound value. |

| `approved` | boolean | yes |  | False until a person approves the entry. |

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `reply_count` | yes |  | Marks the relation as how many replies the agent sends to one user turn. |
| `per_turn` | `one` or `any` | yes |  | one: a single reply to every user turn. any: the agent may send several replies to one turn. Without this relation a map means one. |
| `evidence` | [Evidence](#evidence) | yes |  | Where the entry comes from: a source path and a quote from it. |
| `produced_by` | [Origin](#origin) | yes |  | Who proposed the entry: code (the pre-pass) or a model (a section answer). |
| `approved` | boolean | yes |  | False until a person approves the entry. |

## Proposal relations path end_state

## Proposal relations path end_state expect value

An assertion as a spec writes it; a `{slot}` in a string is replaced by the value the cell binds.

Write one of these forms.

* string
* number
* boolean
* `null`
* a mapping with exactly one of the keys below

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `exact` | JSON value | Equal to this JSON value. |
| `regex` | string, not empty | A JavaScript regular expression source. Specs match text with the m flag. |
| `contains` | string, not empty | Contains this text. |
| `one_of` | list of JSON values, at least 1 item | Equal to one of these values. |
| `nonempty` | `true` | Present and not empty. |
| `absent` | `true` | Absent. |
| `subset` | map of string to JSON value | Holds at least these keys with these values. |
